Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

repeat — to say something again. Example: Could you repeat that?
slow — moving without speed. Example: Could you speak more slowly?
understand — to know what words mean. Example: I don't understand.
mean — to have a particular meaning. Example: What does it mean?
speak — to say words. Example: Could you speak more slowly, please?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Could you speak more slowly, please?
• Could you repeat that?
• What does it mean?
• I don't understand.
• Can you write it down?
